data.one_liner: Displays WebVTT or SRT subtitles in Flutter video players.
data.what_it_does: Parses WebVTT and SRT subtitle files and provides controllers and widgets to render them over video playback. Works with common video players like Chewie and video_player.
use_when: You need to show subtitles/captions for video content in a Flutter app
You require built‑in support for WebVTT and SRT formats without writing your own parser
avoid_when: You need advanced subtitle styling or format support beyond WebVTT/SRT
You require a full‑featured captioning solution with multiple languages or accessibility features
strengths: Simple API for loading and displaying subtitles
Supports both WebVTT and SRT out of the box
Integrates easily with Chewie and video_player
weaknesses: Limited to basic subtitle rendering; no extensive styling options
No support for other subtitle formats (e.g., ASS)
